name: Kokuyoku no Tenshi
source:
"I was waiting... for someone to kill me."

Rain falls endlessly over a husk of a city, silent and oh so full of sorrow.
A boy with no past is found in the ruins—saved not by kindness, but by a girl with a gun.
She doesn’t offer him shelter or food.
Instead, she hands him a weapon and a purpose.

The two are killers, but their targets are only children like them.
As they pull the trigger again and again, they begin to uncover the dark truth behind their orders.
And when they do, they turn their guns... not on the innocent, but on the ones who made them this way.

A story of tragedy, defiance, and the fragile bonds that hold them together.
No matter how many bullets fly near, their love will not be destroyed.

[Translated from [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_8433.html]freegame-mugen[/url]]
translation:
“我在等待……有人来杀我。”

雨无休无止地落在城市的外壳上，沉默而充满悲伤。
一个没有过去的男孩在废墟中被发现——不是被善良所救，而是被一个拿着枪的女孩救了。
她不为他提供住所或食物。
相反，她递给他一件武器和一个目标。

两人都是杀手，但他们的目标却只是像他们这样的孩子。
当他们一次又一次扣动扳机时，他们开始揭开命令背后的黑暗真相。
当他们这样做时，他们就会把枪口转向……不是针对无辜者，而是针对那些造成这种局面的人。

这是一个关于悲剧、反抗以及将他们联系在一起的脆弱纽带的故事。
无论有多少子弹飞近，他们的爱情都不会被摧毁。
